(Retrieved via WebFetch; condensed by fetch tool)

Iran reported eight deaths from US strikes on July 16, 2026. Targeted locations included Qeshm Island, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar, Iranshahr, and Bandar-e Khamir. The US military struck several bridges in Bandar-e Khamir in Hormozgan province.

US Central Command described the operation as effort "to further degrade Iranian military capabilities."
The IRGC claimed attacks on "an airbase used by US forces in Bahrain" in response to what they called a "barbaric" US attack near a children's cancer hospital in Ahvaz.
Iranian Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia warned that attacks "will spread to new areas" if US strikes continued.
White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt stated Trump "is always open to diplomacy" but would hold Iran "accountable."

Kuwait reported 32 drones targeted vital facilities. Qatar said it intercepted an Iranian strike, with a child suffering shrapnel injury. The US military redirected three commercial vessels and disabled one attempting to bypass its blockade.

Sixth consecutive night of US strikes; follows violations of the US-Iran memorandum signed last month, with both sides accusing each other of breaches.
